text:
priya: Quick heads-up — cutoff in ~45m. We need final signoff for the annotated tag + GH draft. Can product confirm changelog blurb?
alex: I'm good on artifacts, just doing a final checksum pass. ping me if you see missing S3 uploads.
jamie: changelog: @jane can you drop the 1-sentence user-facing blurb? we need it in the release notes body. :pray:
jane: adding changelog now, will paste in here in 5.
alex: For anyone doing a local sanity test of annotated tags / push flow, this is my little checklist: create annotated tag, push tag, verify GH draft can be created. Example local commands:```
git tag -a v1.17.0 -m "release: v1.17.0"
git push origin refs/tags/v1.17.0
# if you sign locally: git tag -s v1.17.0 -m "release: v1.17.0"
```
priya: heads-up that CI will try to create the GitHub draft via the release workflow after the tag lands on main. If the tag push fails (auth/GPG), fallback plan is to push unsigned annotated tag and mark the draft note with "unsigned - see infra".
jamie: @alex can you add the artifact SHA lines to the draft body? e.g. `sha256: <hex>` so we have immutability recorded.
alex: will add, I'm running `sha256sum` now against the build artifacts. should be in the draft within 10m.
release-bot: Deploy-check: all checks passed on main branch. Autosigner status: unavailable on CI. Manual signing required.
oliver: If manual signing required, who's on-call to sign tags on the release VM? @alex or @priya?
priya: I can sign if needed but prefer to avoid manual steps. Can someone test pushing an unsigned annotated tag to a throwaway branch and ensure the release job still produces the draft?
jane: changelog pasted: "Improved routing fallback for multi-region deployments; perf tweaks to batching logic." small and product-facing.
ajex: (typo) meant alex: Tested push to a sandbox repo: workflow created a draft for unsigned tag but CI flagged with warning. So draft creation still works.
alex: ok pushing annotated tag to staging refs to simulate: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.17.0:refs/tags/v1.17.0-staging` then trigger release job.
priya: reminder: do not mark the draft as "published" until we confirm signed tag + artifact checksums match. QA wants 1 final smoke on canary.
jamie: QA signoff ETA 25m. Will post here.
oliver: If signing fails at the last minute, fallback: create draft release manually and upload artifacts with checksums, tag the commit locally and log the reason in the draft (transparency).
priya: agreed. Also please ensure SBOM artefact is attached — critical for compliance.
alex: checksum and SBOM uploaded, draft body updated with both SHAs and SBOM link. Pushing annotated tag now.
release-bot: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.17.0 (draft) :package:
jamie: QA smoke ✅ — passing basic end-to-end for routing.
priya: thanks all. final publish window in 15m. If anything blocks, post here ASAP. :thumbsup:
